Definition
[Measurable function] ↗ def:sigma-algebra 1. appE:E.2-def-1\group Measure Theory

A function $f:\mathbb R^n\to \mathbb R$ is measurable if \[ f^{-1}(U)\in \mathcal M \] for every open set $U\subset \mathbb R$.

Continuous functions are measurable. Sums and products of measurable functions are measurable, as are the pointwise $\limsup $ and $\liminf $ of any sequence of measurable functions.
